title: Mumbai Local & Office Gauntlet (Hinglish) — Micro-Utterances, Laughs, Coughs, Angry Clip, Fast/Slow, Echo, Wind & Packet Loss
failure_focus: All-in-one gauntlet: micro-utterances + laughs/coughs + angry clipped + fast panicked + slow hesitant + bot echo + wind + packet loss

source.noise_source: Bundled CC-BY-4.0 VAANI Stems + Procedural Acoustics

transcript_raw: Hi sir, main Rohan bol raha hoon from Mumbai! Quickly block my corporate credit card, abhi just ek unauthorized transaction alert aaya hai! Yes, haan! Hmm. Umm... wait a second sir... let me check the SMS... the merchant name is... uh... Global Mart Online! What?! How can you say the dispute form takes seven days?! Mera paisa abhi hold pe daalo warna main RBI ombudsman mein complaint karunga! Ha ha ha! Oh wait a minute... mere colleague ne abhi bataya ki usne office software renewal ke liye mera corporate card use kiya tha! Okay. Haan, please... sorry for the panic... card ko active hi rehne dijiye... thank you so much.
